# RJW Logistics Group

RJW Logistics Group is a Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage company. RJW Logistics Group delivers industry-leading retail logistics solutions that optimize supply chains, improve performance, and drive scalable business growth. RJW Logistics Group employs 1,111 people (+36.3% YoY, +296 people), founded in 1981. Headquartered in Romeoville, Illinois, United States, with an office in Woodridge. Its workforce is distributed across United States, Mexico, and Venezuela.

## About

RJW Logistics Group is a leading retail logistics and consolidation provider that out-performs the market by bringing your product to the retail shelf on-time, in-full, and at a lower overall cost. We serve over 100 national retailers, delivering our customers’ products 98%+ OTIF on average, and offering compliance solutions that ensure you don’t experience fines and fees. Our full suite of in-house customer solutions and proprietary technologies streamline the supply chain process and simplify your retail efforts, including value-added services, asset-based transportation and warehousing, 99%+ inventory accuracy, automated dispute resolution, online traceability, trade show services, and more.
